page_title: CLion: The IDE for professional C and C++ development

sources.entry: CLion - Powerful C and C++ IDE. (Free for Students)

summary.name: CLion
summary.one_liner: CLion is JetBrains' IDE for professional C and C++ development, with CMake, Makefile, and other build system support, debugging, and AI agent integration.
use_cases: Developing and debugging C and C++ applications
Building CMake or Makefile projects on Windows, Linux, or macOS
Cross-compiling and on-chip debugging for hardware targets
Running AI coding agents alongside a C++ codebase
Migrating C/C++ projects from VS Code
summary.what_it_does: CLion is a C and C++ IDE that opens existing CMake projects, Makefiles, or compilation databases and picks up the toolchain already in use. It provides code understanding, analysis, and navigation, plus debugging, testing, and profiling from within the IDE. Agents such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, Junie, Cursor, and Claude can be connected, and they can use GDB, LLDB, or DAP debuggers to gather stack traces and variable values. The page also describes remote development, unit testing, cross-compilation, and on-chip debugging as core workflow features. JetBrains Air, in early access, is described as a way to run several agents in parallel and review their work in the IDE.
notable: Connects AI agents (Codex, Copilot, Junie, Cursor, Claude, any ACP-compatible agent) and lets agents step into the debugger
Imports existing CMake, Makefile, or compilation database projects and reads VS Code c_cpp_properties.json
Supports a wide range of toolchains and targets including GCC, Clang, MSVC, Zephyr West, Bazel, Docker, and WSL
Free for non-commercial use; 30-day free trial offered
caveats: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a paid subscription
JetBrains Air is in early access
Agent use relies on your own API key, existing subscription, or JetBrains AI
